description: Join us Friday evening, July 31, 2026, at the beautiful Don Gibson Theatre for A Blue‑tiful Evening of HOPE! Enjoy a delicious meal, wonderful live entertainment, and hear inspiring stories from our candidates that you haven’t heard anywhere else. We’ll also have door prizes throughout the night.

title: A Blue-tiful Evening of HOPE — LaKesha Womack for NC-14
